title: CoreTemp / Open Hardware Monitor — TjMax and distance to throttle
description: Every Intel and AMD chip has a TjMax — the junction temperature where it starts throttling — and CoreTemp shows your distance to it, not just the raw number. Twenty degrees of headroom is comfortable; five is a warning written in heat.

title: CoreTemp / Open Hardware Monitor — Per-core readings
